theorems.name: Submission.bf_orthogonal_exists_map_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (W₀ W : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), finrank ℝ W₀ = finrank ℝ W → ∃ h : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint h * h = 1 ∧ W₀.map (h : Rn N →ₗ[ℝ] Rn N) = W
